connections.label: Bibby (invoice finance)
connections.notes: No API found. Monthly statement export. Feeds the cash view add-on.

connections.label: BrightPay (payroll)
connections.notes: No general API found. Payroll cost reaches Xero as a journal; hours, overtime and absence from a monthly CSV export.

connections.label: Falcon Tracking (DOT Tracking)
connections.notes: Mileage, arrival times, idling. Scheduled daily reports by email are supported; API on request.

connections.label: PreDrive (walkaround checks and defects)
connections.notes: Described by Road Tech as DVSA compliant. We read results; we do not rebuild walkaround checks.

connections.label: SharePoint (Microsoft 365)
connections.notes: Microsoft Graph with Sites.Selected: access to named sites only, approved by their Microsoft admin. Spreadsheet layouts must stay the same.

connections.label: Tachomaster (drivers' hours)
connections.notes: No public API found. Road Tech runs integrations for partners; ask once for Tachomaster, Falcon and PreDrive together. Tachomaster can email scheduled reports.

connections.label: Vigo (transport management)
connections.notes: No public API documentation. Ask Vigo for read-only API docs and a key; until then a scheduled daily jobs export (CSV) emailed to the report inbox.

connections.label: Warehouse figures
connections.notes: Source not yet known: a warehouse system, the TMS, or spreadsheets.

connections.label: Xero (accounts)
connections.notes: Public API. Trans Haul's Xero admin approves read-only access once. Developer pricing tiers since March 2026: check cost per connected company.
